title: 第15章 黑珍珠第16章 湛血诀
content_zh:
“身体好些了吗？
杨威抽来条凳子坐在床边观察着许英杰的状况
“多亏丹师出手，我感觉已经好的差不多了”
许英杰微笑回应，气息有些虚弱却明显比昨天好了许多
“嗯，那就好，我这里有一瓶疗伤丹，之后。
每日服用一颗便可，以你的体魄不出七天便可下床活动，只是过两天便要下雪了，还需注意保暖莫要染了风寒”
又替许英杰把了把脉后，杨威拿出一瓶丹药递给许文树
这是他昨晚炼制的里面有两颗中品三颗下品疗伤丹
“前面两天需服用中品，后面三天则服用下品，之后则是静养”
杨威不忘嘱咐一番用药，医者的责任心让他显得格外的细致
看着这一切许英杰轻咬嘴唇，脸蛋微微泛红，这倒不是因为男女之情而是羞愧难当
杨威对他们真是宽容到了极点，不仅免费治疗，还连夜为她炼制了丹药
“杨丹师这怎么使得！
见杨威递来的药瓶许文树也不好意思收了
“我这是为医馆炼制顺便炼的，你姐恢复身体要紧其他的之后再说！
杨威对于人情深谙其道，一番推搡之间便将丹药放进了对方口袋
许文树也知道他的一番美意，他们更是没有拒绝的理由，只能通过言语表达微不足道的感谢
杨威自然有自己盘算，人脉并非只有向上才好，平辈或向下兼容培养有用之人有时更能起到奇效，这许家姐弟没有家族背景便是很好的对象。
“许道友，我看你身上那处伤口不像是妖兽所为啊”
杨威忽而问道

“我们在抵御兽潮之时，遭遇了魔修偷袭几乎全军覆没，我奋死反抗也不是其对手，这一刀便是他留下的，好在后面白长老及时赶到”
许英杰看向腹部心有余悸回忆道，显然那个身披灰袍手握两柄快刀的魔修给她留下了深刻映像
“听周管事说最后还是让他给跑了，不过白长老也说了多亏了姐姐誓死拖住对方，这才他有机会一剑刺中了其要害，如今哪怕逃了也是命不久矣”
许文树明显消息灵通些竟在如此短的时间里收集到了连当事人都不清楚的细节
“既然能从筑基修士的手中逃脱看来那魔修不简单啊”
杨威神色一凛意识到敌人究竟有多棘手，白家长老白云好歹也是筑基初期修士
根据情报那魔修最多炼气圆满，被打成重伤还能逃脱这说明其本事不小
杨威也知道哪怕是都有官家背景，这些势力也是各怀鬼胎，不会联合起来对付魔修
这才让魔修能一直活蹦乱跳到现在，而且看这个样子魔修也清楚这一点，每次犯事后都会安静一段时间
若那家伙找到鹿城还能说是离得近碰巧，选中水司寨就完全没道理了
旁边还有几家修仙势力彼此实力大差不差，对方如此举动很难不让杨威多想
是人都有目的对方的目的又是什么？报仇？夺回宝物？还是来找自己的！
想到此处杨威摸出六神珠又检查了一番，宝物是正常的没有被追踪的任何痕迹
“魔修说不定使用了某种连我也不知道的方法追踪了过来”
“莫非锁定的不是六神珠而是我本人，那被斩了的女邪修口中的主人不一定是这四处捣乱的魔修，很可能在他们身后还有着幕后之人指使，目的又是什么？
content_en:
"Are you feeling better?
Yang Wei pulled out a stool and sat beside the bed to observe Xu Yingjie's condition.
"Thanks to the alchemist's help, I feel almost better."
Xu Yingjie responded with a smile, his breath was a little weak but obviously much better than yesterday.
"Well, that's good, I have a bottle of healing pill here, later.
Just take one pill a day, and you can get out of bed and move around in less than seven days. However, it will snow in two days, so you need to keep warm and avoid catching the wind and cold."
After taking Xu Yingjie's pulse again, Yang Wei took out a bottle of elixir and handed it to Xu Wenshu
This is what he refined last night. It contains two medium-grade and three low-grade healing pills.
"You need to take the middle grade for the first two days, the lower grade for the next three days, and rest after that."
Yang Wei did not forget to give instructions on how to use the medicine. The doctor's sense of responsibility made him particularly meticulous.
Seeing all this, Xu Yingjie bit her lips lightly, her face flushed slightly. This was not because of the love between men and women, but because of shame.
Yang Wei was extremely tolerant towards them. Not only did he treat her for free, but he also refined elixirs for her overnight.
"How could Master Yang do this!
When Xu Wenshu saw the medicine bottle handed over by Yang Wei, he was too embarrassed to accept it.
"I'm just refining it for the medical center. Your sister will have to worry about other things after she recovers!
Yang Wei knew very well about human relationships, and he put the elixir into the opponent's pocket after some pushing and shoving.
Xu Wenshu also knew his kind intentions, and they had no reason to refuse. They could only express their trivial gratitude through words.
Yang Wei naturally has his own calculations. Networking is not only good for those with upward connections. Cultivating useful people through peer or downward compatibility can sometimes work wonders. The Xu family brothers and sisters who have no family background are good candidates.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I don't think the wound on your body was caused by a monster."
Yang Wei suddenly asked
"When we were resisting the beast tide, we encountered a sneak attack by demon cultivators and almost wiped out our entire army. I resisted to the death and was no match for him. This knife was left behind by him. Fortunately, Elder Bai arrived in time."
Xu Yingjie looked at her belly and recalled with lingering fear. Apparently, the demon cultivator wearing a gray robe and holding two sharp knives left a deep impression on her.
"I heard from Manager Zhou that he let him run away in the end, but Elder Bai also said that thanks to his sister holding him back to the death, he had the chance to stab him in the vital part with a sword. Now even if he escapes, he will not die soon."
Xu Wenshu was obviously better informed and had collected details that even the parties involved were unclear about in such a short period of time.
"Since you can escape from the hands of the foundation-building cultivator, it seems that the demon cultivator is not easy."
Yang Wei looked serious and realized how difficult the enemy was. Bai Yun, the elder of the Bai family, was also a monk in the early stage of foundation building.
According to the information, the demon cultivator who has the most complete Qi refining and is able to escape even after being seriously injured shows that he is quite capable.
Yang Wei also knows that even if they all have official backgrounds, these forces have their own agendas and will not unite to deal with demonic cultivators.
This allowed the demon cultivator to be alive and well until now, and it seems that the demon cultivator also knows this. Every time he commits a crime, he will be quiet for a period of time.
If that guy found Lucheng by chance, it would be completely unreasonable to choose Shuisizhai.
There are several immortal cultivating forces nearby who are very different in strength from each other. It is difficult for Yang Wei not to think about the other party's actions.
Everyone has a purpose, but what is the purpose of the other person? Revenge? Get the treasure back? Still come to find yourself!
Thinking of this, Yang Wei took out the Liushen Pearl and checked it again. The treasure was normal and had no trace of being tracked.
"The demon cultivator may have used some method that even I don't know to track him down."
"Could it be that it's not the Six Divine Beads that are targeted but me? The owner of the evil female cultivator who was beheaded is not necessarily the evil cultivator who is causing trouble everywhere. There is probably someone behind the scenes who is behind them. What is the purpose?
